items.title: Make touch movement a first-class input contract
items.why: The latest visual pass made the canvas clearer, but touch devices were still gated by a narrow mobile user-agent check. Solara needs the same immediate movement affordance on phones, tablets, and touch laptops without adding browser token cost or a dependency.
items.recipe: Persist a touch-controls preference, auto-surface controls on coarse-pointer devices, drive movement through the runtime walkability/path logic directly, and add preference regression coverage.

L1.recipe: Replace the mobile user-agent check with coarse-pointer detection and a settings toggle.

L2.recipe: Add persisted touch-controls preference, direct runtime movement ref, visible D-pad overlay, and unit coverage for preference loading.

L3.recipe: Add continuous press-repeat movement, touch action buttons, and browser-level mobile viewport smoke coverage.

items.verification: npm test, npm run smoke, npm run build

skipped.reason: Deferred because the repo currently has no browser runner dependency and adding one would trigger package-trust/install scope beyond this bounded pass.
Deferred to keep input semantics conservative; one tap equals one path nudge, matching keyboard single-key movement.

executionLog.evidence: Added persisted showTouchControls preference, direct touchMoveR movement bridge, coarse-pointer/opt-in D-pad overlay, and preference tests.
